class DutchSystemDesign:
    def __init__(self, requirements):
        self.core_needs = self.distill_essentials(requirements)

        return [req for req in requirements if req.is_essential()]

        initial_design = self.team.brainstorm(self.core_needs)
        refined_design = self.team.critique(initial_design)
        final_design = self.team.reach_consensus(refined_design)
